Proof in the paper: The XRD pattern of CoGa IMC/SiO2 (Fig. 1A) shows characteristic reflections at 2θ = 36.12°, 52.07°, and 76.83°, which are assigned to the (1 0 0), (1 1 0), and (2 0 0) facets of CoGa IMC (PDF-#49–1727), respectively. For comparison, Fig. 1B displays the characteristic reflection of the Co/SiO2 catalyst at 2θ = 52.14°, which is assigned to the (1 1 1) facet of Co (Fm3m, a = 3.54 Å, JCPDS 15–0806).
